[Release Schedule](https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/release_schedule.html)Announcements

---

- **Notice:** The latest annual update was applied during the October 2026 monthly release on November 12, 2026. During the annual update, underlying NAICS codes are revised each year for the previous five years when more accurate and detailed NAICS codes may be available from administrative sources. The Formation series are updated annually to revise information on business formations (firm births) from the Business Dynamic Statistics (BDS) program. Also, seasonal factors are recomputed and applied during the annual update, resulting in revisions to our seasonally adjusted series.
- **Notice**: Annual Business Applications by County was released on June 10, 2026. The annual release adds data for 2025 and incorporates revisions for previously published 2024 and 2023 annual county counts.
- **Notice:** Weekly Business Applications data with industry detail, as classified by the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), were released on March 11, 2026. This updated release adds data through 2025. It also incorporates revisions to the underlying NAICS code assignment methodology for previously published weekly BFS by industry data. The data are available on our [Special Projects](https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/data/weeklynaics.html) portion of our website.
- **Notice:** Annual Island Areas Business Applications were released on March 11, 2026. The annual release adds data for 2025 and incorporates revisions for previously published annual Island Areas counts.
- **Notice:** As of the January 2026 monthly release, applications associated with internet sales are excluded from the high-propensity (HBA) and corporation (CBA) application series. This methodology change was originally scheduled to occur during the November 2025 monthly release. The HBA and CBA definitions are updated for the entire time series. This update is associated with the periodic evaluation of the characteristics associated with high-propensity applications and their likelihood to turn into a business formation.
- **Notice**: Due to a scheduled outage of the Internal Revenue Service's online Employer Identification Number (EIN) Assistant from December 30, 2025 until January 5, 2026, applicants were unable to apply for an EIN through the web application. As a result, the Business Formation Statistics Monthly data for December 2025 and Weekly data for Week 53, 2025 are impacted.
- **Historical Announcements:** See our [Previous Announcements](https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/pdf/previous_announcements.pdf) document for historical BFS announcements.
